name: power
description: Deploy an autonomous engineering team into your own Claude Code session. Describe a goal and Power runs the whole pipeline — research, spec, implementation, review, tests, acceptance, docs — dispatching eight specialist agents through a state machine whose stage boundaries are enforced by deterministic gates running as code, not by asking a model whether it did a good job. Every retry is counted and capped; a run that cannot pass a gate stops and says so instead of looping.
